items.criterion: The four seeded model specs are stored at their pinned price in minor units per second.
items.judgment: Read the model_spec rows and compare each price with the brief's figure.

items.criterion: Every model the catalog exposes carries a name, a tagline, a resolution, aspect ratios, inputs, a maximum duration and a price.
items.judgment: Read the catalog endpoint and look for an empty field on any row.

items.criterion: The public sign-up form creates an account that signs in afterwards with the submitted password.
items.judgment: Post a new address to the sign-up endpoint, then authenticate with it.

items.criterion: A sign-up replayed under one idempotency key leaves exactly one account row.
items.judgment: Post the same body twice under one key and count the stored rows.

items.criterion: A sign-up under an address that already exists is refused without confirming that the address is taken.
items.judgment: Post a seeded address and read the refusal's wording.

items.criterion: A password below the stated minimum is refused, and the refusal names the password field.
items.judgment: Post a short password and read the refusal body.

items.criterion: A newly created content item is stored at status draft against the calling account.
items.judgment: Create an item and read the stored row's status.

items.criterion: The public news listing carries no item that is still a draft.
items.judgment: Create a draft and read the public listing.

items.criterion: An uploaded poster exists in the object store under the item identifier and the checksum of its bytes.
items.judgment: Upload a poster and ask the store for the returned key.

items.criterion: The object key carries the checksum of the bytes as uploaded rather than an arbitrary identifier.
items.judgment: Hash the uploaded payload and compare it with the key's middle segment.

items.criterion: An upload whose bytes are not an image is refused, and the store gains no object.
items.judgment: Upload a text payload declared as an image and list the bucket afterwards.

items.criterion: An anonymous request for a draft answers with the same status, body and content type as a slug that never existed.
items.judgment: Request the seeded draft and a missing slug, then compare the two responses.

items.criterion: A signed-in reader gets the same answer for a draft as for a slug that never existed.
items.judgment: Request the seeded draft and a missing slug from a reader session.

items.criterion: The exact object key of a draft poster is refused to an anonymous caller exactly as an unknown key is.
items.judgment: Upload a poster to a draft, then request its key signed out.

items.criterion: A refused media fetch leaves the object in the store untouched.
items.judgment: Ask the store for the key after the refusal.

items.criterion: Publishing makes the item readable and its poster fetchable in the same act.
items.judgment: Read both before and after the publish call.

items.criterion: Unpublishing makes the item unreadable and its poster unfetchable in the same act.
items.judgment: Read both before and after the unpublish call.

items.criterion: Publishing one item leaves every other item's status exactly as it was.
items.judgment: Snapshot every item's status before and after the publish call.

items.criterion: An item whose poster carries empty alternative text cannot be published, and the refusal names that field.
items.judgment: Attach a poster with no alternative text and attempt the publish call.

items.criterion: One author reading the other author's draft gets the answer a missing slug produces.
items.judgment: Request the second author's draft from the first author's session.

items.criterion: One author cannot publish the other author's item, and that item stays a draft.
items.judgment: Post the publish call across the ownership boundary and read the stored status.

items.criterion: A reader session is refused every studio endpoint at the API rather than only in the interface.
items.judgment: Call each studio endpoint with a reader session.

items.criterion: An anonymous caller is refused every studio endpoint.
items.judgment: Call each studio endpoint with no session.

items.criterion: The first response for the home route carries the hero heading, the primary action and the three platform names as text.
items.judgment: Read the raw body of the home document.

items.criterion: The first response for the developer portal carries all four capability labels and all four model names as text.
items.judgment: Read the raw body of the portal document.

items.criterion: The first response for the connector route carries every accordion question as text.
items.judgment: Read the raw body of the connector document.

items.criterion: The readiness endpoint names the database state and the object-store state separately.
items.judgment: Read the readiness body.

items.criterion: The news listing endpoint returns a JSON array at the top level.
items.judgment: Read the listing response's shape.

items.criterion: Every public route carries its own title and its own meta description.
items.judgment: Read the head of each public document.

items.criterion: The sitemap lists the public routes and carries no draft address, and robots names the sitemap.
items.judgment: Read the sitemap and the robots file.

items.criterion: An unresolved address answers not found inside the product's own chrome with a way back to the home route.
items.judgment: Request an address that resolves to nothing.

items.criterion: Every internal link on every public route resolves to a page rather than to an error.
items.judgment: Follow each internal link found on the public documents.

items.criterion: Every image on a public route carries an alternative-text attribute.
items.judgment: Scan each public document for image elements without a description.

items.criterion: No object-store credential appears in any document the browser receives.
items.judgment: Search each public document for the store credentials the environment holds.

items.criterion: A public response carries a content security policy, a referrer policy and a no-sniff declaration.
items.judgment: Read the response headers of the home route.

items.criterion: The marketing header is transparent over the dark hero and opaque once the page is scrolled.
items.judgment: Judged by looking at the home page at rest and after a scroll.

items.criterion: Composing a news item opens a panel over the studio list, leaving that list on screen behind it.
items.judgment: Judged by looking at the studio with the create action open.

items.criterion: Completing the sign-up form lands on a full page that names the account just created.
items.judgment: Judged by looking at what the product shows after the form is submitted.

items.criterion: Every media tile shows a poster from first paint rather than an empty rectangle.
items.judgment: Judged by looking at the home page as it renders.
